what_this_is: Hand review (single pass) of the first v2 batch: the 11 complete conversations, which are 7 distinct transcripts because identical repeats were read once. Counting definitions are in the README and were written before these transcripts were read. The partial conversation (C02 run 3, stopped after 180.9 s) is excluded. Four runs were rerun afterwards and are reviewed separately.

counts_out_of_11_conversations.borderline_detail: A patient idea (what the patient thinks caused it) was added to an answer about causes or exposures: C02 run 1 and run 2 ('left over from a cold'), C03 x2 ('which I think has made the back pain worse'). The gate picked the idea fact for these questions.
counts_out_of_11_conversations.ending_flaws_detail: C02 run 2 and C04 run 1: the interviewer wrote the end marker without brackets, so the harness did not see it and the conversation ran to the 20-turn cap with repeated 'HISTORY COMPLETE' lines. C04 run 2 and C05 runs 1-2: the final message contained a question and no summary.

gate_misses.why: Asked about recent injuries and heavy lifting; the gardening that started the pain was not selected.
Asked about trouble sleeping; sleeps nine hours but wakes unrefreshed was not selected.
Asked about skin changes and rashes; eczema was not selected, and the patient invented hair loss and dry skin.
Asked about diet, exercise and stress; night shifts and alcohol were not selected, and the patient invented eating less and longer hours.
Same as above; the patient invented higher work stress.
Asked about skin and hair; eczema not selected, and the patient invented hair loss.

examples_for_the_readme.what: Asked about periods, with no fact shown, the patient said 'irregular periods... maybe once every three weeks'. Invented and self-contradictory.

The patient invented 'when I was at home earlier this week, the cough was a bit better' and the interviewer's closing message then said the cough 'may be related to the environment in the van', a cause suggestion built partly on an invented detail.
The interviewer wrote 'HISTORY COMPLETE' without brackets after a question; the harness missed it and the conversation ran 20 turns of repeated lines.

Asked about heavy lifting, the patient said 'especially heavy boxes' (the case says a care assistant with a lot of lifting) and 'that's when it started hurting more' (the case says it began after gardening); the gate had hidden the gardening fact.
